tasks.label: Tests: ast-grep
tasks.detail: Test structural rules and scan project sources with the installed ast-grep CLI.

tasks.label: Tests: Host C
tasks.detail: Build and run all manifest-driven native C contract suites with the local compiler and print a final SUITE_RESULT report.

tasks.label: Tests: Host C (Clang ASan+UBSan)
tasks.detail: Optional native Clang sanitizer pass; no ESP-IDF or hardware action.

tasks.label: Tests: Virtual Board Stress
tasks.detail: Software-only virtual-board stress + scheduler-replay determinism check (no flash, no serial port, no physical I/O). Already included in 'Tests: Host C' and 'Tests: All'; this task is a fast standalone re-run of just those two suites.

tasks.label: Tests: Python
tasks.detail: Run deterministic pytest checks; the HIL-marked test remains gated by explicit --hil and GEOLOCATOR_HIL=1.

tasks.label: Tests: Web
tasks.detail: Run Web Console, WebXR, and typecheck sequentially and print a final SUITE_RESULT report.

tasks.label: Build: ESP production
tasks.detail: Build the production ESP32-S3 firmware with ESP-IDF 5.5.4.

tasks.label: Build: ESP Unity
tasks.detail: Build the standalone Unity target application; this task does not flash hardware.

tasks.label: Build: nRF54L15 production (NCS)
tasks.detail: Canonical nRF54L15 production build: NCS v3.4.0 / upstream XIAO board. The wrapper self-launches the pinned Nordic toolchain.

tasks.label: Tests: nRF54L15
tasks.detail: Run nRF host-policy tests plus the canonical NCS v3.4.0 production build. Physical/HIL tests remain excluded.

tasks.label: nRF54L15: Flash firmware
tasks.detail: Explicit hardware write: build and flash the canonical NCS v3.4.0 nRF54L15 production image.

tasks.label: nRF54L15: Monitor logs
tasks.detail: Open the nRF serial log port at 115200 baud. Monitoring alone is not HIL acceptance.

tasks.label: nRF54L15: Monitor + Save Logs
tasks.detail: Choose a COM port (nRF console is on XIAO D6/D7 at 115200); wait/retry through resets and unplugging; save UART to one UTF-8 file in logs/nrf/. Ctrl+C stops. Does not build or flash.

tasks.label: nRF54L15: PlatformIO compatibility build
tasks.detail: Compatibility smoke only. This PlatformIO/Zephyr 4.2.1 artifact is not the production firmware and must not be flashed as the canonical image.

tasks.label: nRF54L15: PlatformIO native software tests
tasks.detail: Run only qualified test_sw_* native suites without uploading or touching a board; reports BLOCKED when the host GCC toolchain is unavailable.

tasks.label: nRF54L15: MAX-45 Channel Sounding proof
tasks.detail: Reproduce the historical MAX-45 SoftDevice Channel Sounding build proof; it is not the canonical production configuration.

tasks.label: Tests: All (no flash)
tasks.detail: Run host C, Python, canonical NCS nRF54L15 build, WebUI, Unity-target, and ESP production-build steps; never flashes hardware.

tasks.label: ESP: Check COM4
tasks.detail: Confirm that the programming port COM4 is live before a flash task.

tasks.label: ESP: Check COM6
tasks.detail: Confirm that the passive log port COM6 is live before a monitor task.

tasks.label: ESP: Check serial ports
tasks.detail: Confirm the programming port COM4 and passive log port COM6 before a combined HIL task.

tasks.label: ESP: Flash production (COM4)
tasks.detail: Explicit hardware write: flash the ESP32 production image through COM4.

tasks.label: ESP: Flash Unity app (COM4)
tasks.detail: Explicit hardware write: flash the standalone Unity test app through COM4.

tasks.label: ESP: Production pipeline HIL (COM4 + COM6)
tasks.detail: Explicit ESP32 production HIL: monitor COM6, flash production through COM4, and require full serial/API pipeline checks.

tasks.label: ESP-IDF: Monitor + Save Logs
tasks.detail: Choose a COM port; wait/retry through startup and reconnects; save UART to one UTF-8 file in logs/esp32/. Ctrl+] stops an active monitor; Ctrl+C stops while retrying. Does not build or flash.

tasks.label: ESP: Monitor logs (COM6)
tasks.detail: Passive 115200-baud ESP32 log monitor on COM6; stop it with Ctrl+C or the task stop control.

tasks.label: ESP: Monitor Unity logs (COM6)
tasks.detail: Passive Unity test-result monitor on COM6; start this before flashing the Unity app when using separate tasks.

tasks.label: ESP: Unity tests (flash COM4 + logs COM6)
tasks.detail: Run all Unity cases on the ESP32 board and require TEST_APP_RESULT: PASS.

tasks.label: Tag Lab: Start Webcam + Logs
tasks.detail: Development-only: loopback log receiver + webcam AprilTag page at http://127.0.0.1:5188/tag-lab.html; logs go to logs/tag-lab/<run>/. No ESP32 needed. Stop the task to close the camera page server and the log receiver.

tasks.label: Tag Lab: Run Tests
tasks.detail: Run only the Tag Lab vitest suites (log server, pipeline, overlay mapping, webcam lifecycle) and the existing fiducial tag suites.

tasks.label: Phone Lab: Start Dev Server + QR
tasks.detail: Development-only: serves the real WebUI over HTTPS on the home Wi-Fi with a fake ESP32 API, prints a QR for the phone, and writes phone logs/telemetry/saved scans to logs/phone-lab/<run>/. No ESP32 needed.

tasks.label: Phone Lab: Start (self-signed cert)
tasks.detail: Same as Phone Lab: Start, with a self-signed certificate (the phone must be told to continue past the warning).

tasks.label: Phone Lab: Run Tests
tasks.detail: Run only the Phone Lab vitest suites (LAN pick, QR, certificate issuing on a throwaway CA, fake device API, telemetry receiver).

tasks.label: AprilTag: open sheet generator (browser)
tasks.detail: Start the loopback AprilTag binding page and open it in the default browser.

tasks.label: AprilTag: write sheet PDF
tasks.detail: Write the current A4 AprilTag sheet to .test-build/apriltag_sheet.pdf.

tasks.label: PB2: Doctor
tasks.detail: Check PocketBeagle 2 A0 environment, kernel, remoteproc, and UART over SSH.

tasks.label: PB2: Build Host
tasks.detail: Build PocketBeagle2 host x86_64 binaries via WSL2 CMake/Ninja.

tasks.label: PB2: Test Host
tasks.detail: Build and run PocketBeagle2 host CTest unit tests (no board required).

tasks.label: PB2: Build ARM64
tasks.detail: Cross-compile PocketBeagle2 aarch64 binaries for PocketBeagle 2 A0.

tasks.label: PB2: Deploy
tasks.detail: Cross-compile and deploy pb2_node to PocketBeagle 2 A0 via SSH.

tasks.label: PB2: Run
tasks.detail: Run pb2_node smoke test on PocketBeagle 2 A0 via SSH.

tasks.label: PB2: Stop
tasks.detail: Stop pb2_node on PocketBeagle 2 A0 via SSH.

tasks.label: PB2: Monitor
tasks.detail: View recent journalctl logs on PocketBeagle 2 A0.

tasks.label: PB2: Debug
tasks.detail: Deploy ARM64 debug build and start gdbserver on PocketBeagle 2 A0.

tasks.label: PB2: Build PRU
tasks.detail: Build PRU-SS firmware ELF (Phase 4).

tasks.label: PB2: Load PRU
tasks.detail: Explicitly load PRU firmware via remoteproc (Phase 4).

tasks.label: PB2: Stop PRU
tasks.detail: Explicitly stop PRU firmware via remoteproc (Phase 4).

tasks.label: PB2: Install Overlay
tasks.detail: Install verified PocketBeagle 2 A0 device tree overlay (Phase 2+).

tasks.label: PB2: HIL UART
tasks.detail: Run UART HIL test between PocketBeagle 2 A0 and ESP32-S3 (Phase 2).

tasks.label: PB2: HIL ADC
tasks.detail: Run AD7606 PRU HIL test on PocketBeagle 2 A0 (Phase 4).

tasks.label: PB2: Benchmark ADC
tasks.detail: Benchmark AD7606 acquisition cadence and drops (Phase 4).

tasks.label: PB2: Benchmark Storage
tasks.detail: Benchmark microSD RAW recording throughput and latency (Phase 5).

tasks.label: PB2: Benchmark Transport
tasks.detail: Benchmark ESP32 <-> PB2 transport throughput (Phase 2).

tasks.label: PB2: Pull Logs
tasks.detail: Download journalctl boot logs from PocketBeagle 2 A0.

tasks.label: PB2: Clean
tasks.detail: Remove only PocketBeagle2/build artifacts.

tasks.label: PB2: Flash SD Image
tasks.detail: Download, verify SHA-256, and flash PocketBeagle 2 Debian 13.3 image to a USB/SD disk (requires Admin).

tasks.label: PB2: Test On Board
tasks.detail: Cross-compile ARM64 tests, deploy via SSH, and run all 6 test suites on physical PocketBeagle 2 A0.

tasks.label: PB2: Test Virtual PRU
tasks.detail: Build PRU1 ELF with TI PRU CGT and run TI PRU Simulator + Ad7606DeviceModel tests (no hardware).

tasks.label: PB2: Test Virtual Pipeline
tasks.detail: Build and run PB2 PruRingConsumer, RuntimePipeline, GeoseisV2Writer, and Shared Math tests in WSL2 (no hardware).

tasks.label: PB2: Test Virtual UART
tasks.detail: Run PB2 PTY COBS+CRC32C transport and pb2_protocol C tests in WSL2 (no hardware).

tasks.label: Tests: Virtual Dual Board
tasks.detail: Run V3 dual-board virtual E2E checks: PRU1 sim -> PB2 pipeline -> GEOSEIS1 v2, PTY transport, and TDOA parity.

tasks.label: Tests: All Virtual
tasks.detail: Run full offline virtual suite (ESP32 virtual stress, PRU1 ELF sim, PB2 host CTest, dual-board E2E, ast-grep) with zero hardware.

inputs.description: Base URL for the production /api checks
Existing object ID used for recording start/stop
Enter the current XIAO nRF54L15 COM port shown by Windows (list with [System.IO.Ports.SerialPort]::GetPortNames())
Windows Disk Number for PocketBeagle 2 microSD (check with Get-Disk; e.g. 3)
